rd.text:

Gross profit margin has been and will continue to fluctuate over time affected by a variety of factors, including the average sales price of our product and service offerings and changes in our mix of revenue between ESS products, drone batteries, battery materials and service offerings to automotive OEMs and other manufacturers .

Gross margin for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 was 4.9% and 14.6%, respectively, compared to 51.1% and 65.7%, for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively. The decrease was primarily due to the effect of changing revenue mix between product and service offerings.

cor.heading: Cost of Revenue
cor.text:
Cost of revenue includes materials, labor, depreciation and amortization expense, inventory, freight costs, warranty, and other direct costs related to manufacturing our products and service contracts. Labor consists of personnel-related expenses such as salaries, benefits, and stock-based compensation .

Costs of revenue for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $6.3 million and $15.7 million, respectively. Cost of revenue increased by $2.8 million and $10.1 million, or 81.3% and 178.7%, respectively, compared to the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, which had costs of revenue of $3.5 million and $5.6 million, respectively. The increased costs of revenue was primarily driven by increased product revenue for ESS product sales from UZ Energy, which was acquired in the third quarter of 2025, while service revenue from OEMs decreased due to the service period ending in the fourth quarter of 2025.

opex.text: We expect to sustain substantial operating expenses, without generating sufficient revenues to cover expenditures, for several years. We believe that our cash-on-hand and marketable debt and equity securities will be sufficient to meet our principal working capital and capital expenditure requirements and fund our ongoing research and development, operational and commercial activities, for at least 12 months from the date of this Quarterly Report. These requirements and activities include activities related to the ESS business, planned NDAA-compliant manufacturing capacity for drone cell development, working capital requirements for MUMPL, and commercialization of Molecular Universe material discoveries.

rd.text: Research and development expenses include personnel-related expenses, such as salaries, benefits, and stock-based compensation, for scientists, experienced engineers and technicians. These expenses also cover materials and supplies used in product research and development, process engineering efforts and testing, payments made to consultants, and patent related legal costs. ga.heading: General and Administrative
ga.text:
General and administrative expenses include personnel-related expenses, such as salaries, benefits, and stock-based compensation for our finance, legal and human resource functions. These expenses also cover director and officer insurance, outside contractor fees, and professional services, including audit, compliance, legal, accounting, investor relations, and other advisory services. Additionally, the expenses encompass allocated facilities and information technology costs, such as depreciation and amortization .

General and administrative expenses for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased $2.5 million, or 37.4%, to $9.2 million, compared with $6.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. This increase was primarily driven by a $1.1 million increase in professional services including marketing and public relations, a $1.0 million increase for personnel costs and stock-based compensation due to increased headcount, and a $0.6 million increase in legal expenses. These increases were partially offset by a $0.2 million decrease in other expenses.

General and administrative expenses for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased $5.7 million, or 27.7%, to $26.2 million, compared with $20.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
